Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Diamond Patterned Area Rug, 5'9" x 3'9", Grey Ivory
Colors: Grey,ivory
This modern rug brings sophistication to any room with its intricate diamond-within-a-diamond pattern. Low- and high-pile loops are combined to create a three-dimensional look and feel. The durable fabric is ready for high-traffic areas. 7'6" x 2'3" High-low medium pile is easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
